_note: Public runtime config only. The Supabase anon (publishable) key is designed to be exposed in browser code; every protection comes from row-level security and storage policies. NEVER put a service-role key here.
_analytics: Google Analytics is OFF until gaId holds a GA4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX). The ID is public by design, like the key above: it names a property, it grants nothing. Setting it adds a Google Analytics choice to the consent banner, OFF until a visitor turns it on, and nothing is sent to Google before that. Leave it empty and no Google code is loaded by anybody.
